decisions.statement: The first tick after a start opens at the newest row already there.
The cursor moves past each notification and only forward.
A push that throws is complained about rather than retried.
A push delivered to a phone is named as soon as that phone has it.
A device token taken away is named as soon as that token is gone.
The cursor moves past a notification whose push threw.
With no sender the cursor still moves past every notification.
Nothing the cursor has moved past is pushed once a sender is set.
A person with no device is said aloud rather than treated as a fault.
A tick past its ceiling is ended rather than left to run beside the next tick.
No push has an app-icon badge.
Nothing here refreshes an app-icon badge.
Nothing here waits between one tick and the next.

definition: one round of the notifier: read what is new in the feed and push each of it
